posts.title: Gel polish at home: what to do and what to skip
posts.body:
Thin coats cure better than thick ones. Wipe the nail with alcohol before the base coat, and cap the free edge of the nail every time.

Skip peeling gel off with your fingers. Soak a cotton pad in acetone, wrap each nail in foil for ten minutes, and the polish will slide off without taking your nail with it.

posts.title: Build a capsule wardrobe in one weekend
posts.body:
On Saturday, take everything out and sort it into three piles: wear weekly, wear sometimes, never wear. Be honest about the third pile.

On Sunday, look at what is left and write down the gaps. Buy only what fills a gap, and buy it in a colour you already own twice.

posts.title: Five nail colours that work with everything
posts.body:
If you only want a few polishes in your drawer, start with these: a sheer milky pink, a deep burgundy, a true red, a soft taupe and a glossy black.

Pick two for work weeks and keep the red for the days you want to feel put together.
